ItemEffectBus.why: KartDriver+0x304. The u64 at 0x10 that the KartStatus views test is ItemEffectBus.mask (ItemEffectBus_* functions set it); KartStatus was a second name for the same object.

KartDriver.why: names at 0x0-0x20 from KartDriver_Render (LOD selection, driver/accessory trees) and KartDriver_Dtor; 0xE8 is the four wheel joints (KartDriver_SetUniformScale_4Wheels). Driver, KartRender, RenderObj, KartItem, DispatchKart and Kart are the same object under other names: they agree with KartDriver on 0x1F4/0x1F8 (slot, character), 0x248, 0x2D0 and the pointer at 0x304, with no overlapping member. Not aliases: BoostKart (int/float at 0x08/0x0C), KartObj, KartPreview, and the `Kart` in kartmove/fn_8019A8A4.c (a Vec3 position at 0x40, where KartDriver has model pointers).

NokoNoko.why: NokoNoko_InitEntity.c labelled 0x0C/0x10/0x18 one slot off (model/anim/extra); every other user reads 0x0C as the state and 0x10 as the model handle, and Update counts 0x18 down as a timer.

NokoKind.why: InitEntity copies kind[0], [4], [8] into NokoNoko 0x0C/0x10/0x18 (state, model, timer); names follow NokoNoko.

SpriteHandle.why: 0x78-0x84 are the four GXSetBlendMode arguments (SpriteHandlePool passes them in order); 0xD8-0xE0 is the draw callback and its argument.

KartAudioChannel.why: KartAudioChannel.c only had placeholders; names from SoundVolumePan_Update (volume/pitch chase their targets) and the Play*SE users.

RaceScene.why: The 0x580-byte struct in Scene_8014E0C4.cpp is another scene class (script-driven, 21 objects, 48 sprites), not the race mode object.

HSD_JObj.why: HAL sysdolphin HSD_JObj (same offsets as the SSBM decomp, include/sysdolphin/baselib/jobj.h): HSD_Obj header, next/parent/child, flags, the dobj union, rotate (quaternion or euler in xyz), scale, translate, mtx, then scl/envelope/aobj/robj/desc. Views that spelled the vectors as scalars now use rotate.x, scale.y, translate.z.
